system.description: An older, more experienced Cainite who aids you, at a cost. Calling on a mentor requires a Simple Test — win and the mentor helps freely, tie and a favor is owed in return, lose and the favor must be paid up front. A mentor can be called on once per session. Higher ratings let a mentor share specialized information, lend Background Traits, or teach Disciplines and rare Abilities you don't otherwise have access to.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
